Name: Aquatic Barn
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
If you have any mods that add aquatic animals like my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43308]Marine Livestock mod[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43463]Em's River Wildlife[/url], or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36681]Waterside Flamingos[/url], you may have wished for a water-themed building for them before. Well, here you go!

This building can be ordered from Robin for 12,000g, 200 stone and 300 wood. It can house both barn and coop animals and holds up to 18 animals. There's a config for both the interior and exterior to be vanilla colors or desaturated. It comes with an auto-feeder, a regular incubator and an ostrich incubator.

Future plans: Seasonal looks. Expand the inside and add an indoor pond for your beauties to swim in.

Enjoy!
